verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The marketing line about agents having 'credentials already in place' (modal-docs-3) says nothing about scoping or least privilege, and the network allowlist parameters are an adjacent sandbox-isolation control, not credential scoping. The axis applies to a sandbox platform for agents, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
